goal: Write the project config: site URL, server-rendered output deployed with the Node adapter in standalone mode, React components enabled, and a sitemap generated.

Write the project config with English and Spanish locales (English default, no prefix for the default), and a typed environment variable schema with a public client-side API URL and a secret server-side API key.
Write an API route that returns a JSON list on GET and on POST reads a JSON body, sets an http-only session cookie, and responds 201; reject bad input with a 400.

Write request middleware made of two steps run in order: one that redirects visitors without a session cookie away from /dashboard, and one that adds a response header with the request duration and exposes the user to pages.

Write the content collections config: a blog collection loaded from Markdown files in src/content/blog with a schema (title, publish date, optional cover image, draft flag) and an authors collection loaded from a single JSON file.
Write a custom content loader that fetches products from a remote JSON API at build time, validates each entry, and stores them so pages can query the collection.
Write a custom integration that injects a /health route, adds a small script to every page, and logs the output directory when the build finishes.
Define a server action that accepts a newsletter signup form (email, validated), returns a typed result, and throws a typed error when the email is already subscribed.
